sense: one option a slot may take
definition: One option a slot may take: a side gable and a hip are two variants of the roof form. A style marks each variant canonical, permitted, atypical or forbidden, and most of what it says about a slot is which options it refuses.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a slot's variants: "Records, not bare strings. Most of what a style says about a slot is which options it REFUSES", each carrying a status: "canonical: the default a generator should reach for. permitted: correct but not first choice." kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json lists side-gable and hip among the variants of roof_form, whose rule reads "The roof is one simple solid about one ridge".
